description: Book a visit to a job at a time, optionally with the workers going (assignee_ids, a saved crew_id, or both). Overlaps for those workers come back in conflicts.

arrival_window_minutes.description: Arrival window in minutes: the customer is told the worker arrives between starts_at and starts_at plus this. Defaults to the shop's setting (schedule.setRules).

priority.description: normal (default), urgent or emergency. Urgent and emergency visits send visit.priority_set and can use dispatch.suggest.

name: visits_create
